name: skirt Belt
shortDescription: A modular three-piece skirt and two-piece armored belt based on a Prince Armory pattern, using snaps to support interchangeable skirt styles.
description: This project uses a pattern owned by Prince Armory and combines a three-piece skirt with a two-piece armored belt. I added snaps so the skirt sections can be changed instead of permanently fixing one style to the belt.
I made both a scale-mail version and a black leather version of the skirt. The armored belt itself is black with gold accents.
